Subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff & next steps

Thanks again for the time this morning — really appreciated the overview of Acme's current search and summarization workflow. I captured a few quick notes and proposed next steps below.

Notes from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce latency for customer-facing summaries and improve factuality for long documents
- Success criteria: 90th percentile latency under 400ms for short queries; 95% factuality on our internal eval prompt set
- Key constraints: data residency for PII-sensitive docs, and procurement timeline targeting end of Q2

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-min evaluation kickoff: technical deep dive + trial plan review (team: Marissa, Connor + Acme engineering/product)
2) Share evaluation plan (incl. prompt set, metrics, timeline) and pre-kickoff checklist
3) Kick off 2-week trial with success criteria and checkpoints

I can run the kickoff and Connor will handle the technical architecture & deployment options. I attached the draft eval plan for your review (redwood_eval_plan_v1.pdf).

Available slots this week (PST):
- Thu 02/25 11:00-12:00
- Thu 02/25 15:00-16:00
- Fri 02/26 09:30-10:30

If none of those work, please share 2-3 times that do and I'll coordinate. Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with the plan and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks team — quick confirmation from my side: I'll prepare a short runbook covering required GPU types, estimated network egress, and options for running the trial inside your us-west tenancy with strict log controls.

High-level rough numbers for the kickoff (will refine once I see prompt set):
- Minimum footprint: 1x A10G equivalent for baseline throughput testing
- Recommended for higher concurrency: 2x A40/A100 pool with autoscale for burst testing
- We support running entirely within your VPC or our dedicated us-west region with log export disabled — we'll walk through both options and tradeoffs.

Look forward to Thursday.
